description: A premium, responsive 3D portfolio for an electrical engineering student, with a working contact service.

services.name: Portfolio website
services.description: Responsive React portfolio with a fixed Three.js electrical scene, scroll-driven coil morph, project and journey content, and contact form.

services.name: Contact API
services.description: Express API for health checks and validated contact submissions, MongoDB persistence, and email notifications.

questions.question: Which language should the portfolio frontend use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Recommended for type-safe React components, form handling, and Three.js integration.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Use JavaScript without static type checking.

questions.rationale: The provided specification explicitly requires TypeScript.

questions.question: Which frontend framework and build setup should be used?

options.label: React 19 with Vite
options.description: Recommended and explicitly requested; supports the specified React Three Fiber scene.

options.label: Other
options.description: Enter a different framework or build setup.

questions.rationale: The provided specification explicitly requires React 19 and Vite.

questions.question: Which key frontend features should the portfolio include?
questions.recommendedChoice: 3D electrical scene and scroll-morphing coil; content-driven sections; accessible responsive layout; validated contact form
questions.answer: 3D electrical scene and scroll-morphing coil; content-driven sections; accessible responsive layout; validated contact form
questions.rationale: These features are specified in the supplied project brief.

questions.question: Which language should the contact API use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Recommended for a typed Express API and shared validation patterns.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Use JavaScript without static type checking.

questions.rationale: The provided specification explicitly requires TypeScript.

questions.question: Which backend framework and runtime should be used?

options.label: Express 5 on Node.js 22
options.description: Recommended and explicitly requested for the contact and health endpoints.

options.label: Other
options.description: Enter a different backend framework or runtime.

questions.question: Which key backend features should the contact API include?

questions.answer: Zod validation; MongoDB persistence; SMTP owner notification and visitor auto-reply; honeypot; per-IP rate limiting; strict CORS; Helmet; pino logging
